title: PAR-134 VISUALSTYLE C5 source-method replay
mode: class-level generated AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 fast test slice
scope: Extend the CMC consumer audit to a consumer that retains raw source method/value metadata
Verify C5 Foreground normalizes to scalar ACI 7 without losing raw identity on unchanged same-version replay
Verify a scalar edit replaces stale raw C5 metadata with canonical indexed ACI output

localSource.finding: DRW_VisualStyle::parseDwg stores the raw packed CMC word, flags, and names in DRW_VisualStyleEncoding while exposing a normalized integer view; its encoder replays those source bytes only while the source representation remains applicable to the unchanged scalar. The generic getCmColor path maps C5 to scalar 7 while preserving the optional raw method output.
localSource.limit: This class-level result does not characterize every getCmColor consumer or establish a real producer's C5 payload/name encoding.

generatedControls.finding: The generated VISUALSTYLE edgeColor uses packed C5 word 0xC5000007. Tests assert normalized scalar 7, retained raw C5 word, exact same-version body re-encoding, and scalar edit to 8 producing canonical C3 word 0xC3000008.
generatedControls.limit: The C5 packed word is generated test data, not an eligible producer sample or a C5 payload grammar claim.

officialSemantics.finding: The documented API identifies C5 as Foreground, ACI foreground as 7, and both representations as foreground-equivalent.
officialSemantics.limit: API semantics do not establish DWG producer payload bytes.

generatedTestSummary: Changed one generated VISUALSTYLE color method to C5 and asserted its ACI-7 scalar view plus raw method identity.
Added an edited-scalar control to ensure canonical C3 output replaces stale C5 source data.
Added the focused --visualstyle-cmc-source-replay selector and CTest registration.

assessment.confirmedLocalResult: For the generated AC1024/AC1027/AC1032 VISUALSTYLE vectors, the C5 source method is retained for unchanged same-version replay, scalar projection is 7, and an explicit scalar edit does not replay stale C5 bytes.
unresolved: The broader class-by-class CMC consumer audit remains open, especially for scalar-only fields that cannot retain method or RGB metadata.
Real producer C5 payload and optional-name behavior remain unqualified.
C4 and C6-C8 remain unsupported for third-party semantic projection; their generic fallback policy is not promoted as correct.
HATCH-gradient C5 read/write remains gated on eligible producer evidence.
Native and independent semantic qualification remain separate gates.
assessment.nextAction: Continue the CMC consumer inventory and identify the first scalar-only consumer with a locally defensible preservation or refusal correction before changing shared fallback behavior.
